title: Wildfires and Stubborn Inflation Put Greece's Recovery Narrative Under… · 18 Aug
keywords: Greece, wildfires, inflation, fiscal policy, climate adaptation, tourism, cost of living, tax evasion, Bank of Greece, Eurostat, European Union, Mediterranean, civil protection, household finances
notes: Greece is confronting two overlapping crises that are testing both its public finances and its political credibility: an escalating wildfire season that officials now describe as a medium- and long-term fiscal risk, and a cost-of-living squeeze that official statistics have not fully resolved. The government argues it is managing both with discipline and foresight, but critics and households tell a more complicated story. For the European Union, Greece's predicament is a preview of pressures other frontline climate states may soon face.
